name: Canopy and Lid (Hoa Cái Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: while a foe carries both your Earth and your Mercury stacks, your ward regains 3 % each second, and each fan art adds one more Mercury stack to it.

story: The founder's furnace and the fan the Mistress took up the year he went blind. She says the two were always meant to be used together; he says he never had a fan.

name: The Sealed Room (Phong Thất Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: A Room Full of Fume (Mãn Thất Yên)
bonuses.rule: each second, the foe gains one Mercury stack; the Gourd's lingering poison no longer stays on you but goes to the foe when you drink.

story: What the founder kept when he gave the Hall away: his gourd, his robe, and the censer lit the day he went blind. He has not let the Mistress take any of it out of the room.
